ADK_TEST_GO=1 compares all 182 raw Rust encodings and their Go typed re-encodings against independent expectations.

Store/backend durability, PostgreSQL behavior, exactly-once guarantees
Exhaustive validation of malformed inputs or unmarshalling into prepopulated records
